profile.name: Prateek Saxena
profile.headline: Group General Manager at Al Zaabi Group | Driving Growth with Analytical Strategy
profile.about:
At the helm of Al Zaabi Group, I lead the strategic direction and operational management of portfolio encompassing 42 companies across diverse sectors including Healthcare, Automotive, Contracting, E-commerce, Real Estate, Building Materials, Education, F&B, Retail, Trading, and Manufacturing. Driving transformative growth and innovation across this expansive ecosystem has been both a challenge and passion that defines my leadership journey.

My path has been marked by a consistent drive to transform opportunities into tangible results. Through strategic foresight and decisive action, I have successfully established and scaled international brands across the UAE. This journey has reinforced my belief in the power of collaborative leadership and data-driven decision-making to create sustainable business value.

As a proud alumnus of Purdue University and INSEAD, I bring a blend of global perspective and local expertise to every challenge. This educational foundation has proven invaluable in navigating complex market dynamics and fostering innovation across our diverse portfolio. My leadership approach centers on building high-performing teams and cultivating an environment where strategic thinking meets operational excellence.

In today's rapidly evolving business landscape, I focus on spearheading digital transformation initiatives while identifying strategic growth opportunities that position our organization at the forefront of industry innovation. My commitment to operational excellence and sustainable growth continues to drive our expansion into new markets and sectors, always with an eye toward creating lasting value for our stakeholders.

roles.title: Operations & Strategy Manager
roles.description: Responsible for operations of 17 group companies. Strategy development for all divisions of the group.

experience.note: Concurrent with Al Zaabi Group GM role

roles.title: Corporate Strategy Officer
roles.description: Managing overall strategic and financial operation of 5 group companies engaged in activities like Infrastructure construction, Capital Market Investments, Manufacturing, Venture Capitalism, Real Estate and Trading.

roles.title: Business Analyst
roles.description: Assisted CFO to restructure group manufacturing company and performed due diligence on new ventures.

recommendation.text: Having worked with Prateek for the past one year, I found him to have high drive and energy which combines with good work ethics. Prateek has high potential to grow and works well when given autonomy and responsibility to act. He is an analytical thinker and commercially astute. I see Prateek multitasking and handling various portfolios of the group businesses and operational issues with a balanced approach. He has the potential to be a part of any progressive management team and add value to the business.

recent_posts.text:
As we step into 2026, I extend my heartfelt gratitude to the incredible teams across Al Zaabi Group. 2025 reminded us that resilience and collaboration drives real progress. Thank you to everyone who made it meaningful.

New year. New goals. Same commitment to excellence.

Looking ahead, we're focused on building stronger partnerships, embracing innovation, and creating lasting value across every sector we serve.

Here's to building something even greater in 2026. Happy New Year!

Yesterday, we celebrated 360 years of Saint-Gobain with a successful event held at one of our branches in Abu Dhabi with the SG Demo Van, showcasing the innovation of Saint-Gobain Weber France & Gyproc. The turnout was fantastic. The event featured live product demonstrations and hands on experiences. This event reinforced the strong partnership between Al Zaabi Group and Saint-Gobain Gulf Countries. Our collaboration is built on trust and a commitment to delivering excellence in building material solutions across the UAE.

Al Zaabi Group was honored to host our Annual Iftar Gathering at Sofitel Abu Dhabi Corniche, celebrating the spirit of Ramadan with our valued partners and community. We extend our heartfelt gratitude to the distinguished guests from the Royal Family, leaders from government sectors, valued business partners, senior executives across industries, cherished community representatives, and our dear colleagues who graced the occasion with their presence.

Excited to share highlights from our recent training event hosted by Henkel Polybit at our NH47 Restaurant! As a strategic distributor for Henkel, the session was incredibly informative, providing our team with updated in-depth knowledge across all their product categories, including waterproofing solutions, tiling, flooring, and more.

Wishing you and your loved ones peace, happiness, and countless blessings on this special occasion. May this Eid bring with it the spirit of unity, compassion, and gratitude and may your home be filled with warmth, joy, and prosperity.
